optimizedCv.targetRoleTitle: Supply Planning Analyst, Supply Chain Collaboration

professionalSummary.text: Supply Planning Analyst with two years of experience maintaining planning parameters, preparing draft supply plans, and leading supplier planning communications for a small-appliance product family.
professionalSummary.witness: Maintained planning parameters for the small-appliance product family in the planning system, updating lead times and safety stock after each supplier review and logging every change with its reason.

professionalSummary.text: Documented plan changes and responsibilities through detailed change logs and exception lists, ensuring accountability for schedule adherence.
professionalSummary.witness: Passed plan changes from production and logistics into the draft plan, flagging the ones that needed the senior planner's decision and recording who decided in the change log.

experienceHighlights.text: Maintained planning parameters (lead times, safety stock, lot sizes) in the planning system for a small-appliance product family, updating after each supplier review and logging all changes with reasons.
experienceHighlights.witness: Maintained planning parameters for the small-appliance product family in the planning system, updating lead times and safety stock after each supplier review and logging every change with its reason.

experienceHighlights.text: Prepared draft weekly supply plans and exception lists for a small-appliance product family, with the senior planner releasing purchase schedules under her authority.
experienceHighlights.witness: Prepared the draft weekly supply plan and the exception list for the family; the senior planner reviewed the draft and released the purchase schedules to suppliers under her authority.

experienceHighlights.text: Documented weekly supplier planning calls chaired by a senior planner, tracking actions in a shared log and chasing supplier confirmations between calls.
experienceHighlights.witness: Took the minutes of the weekly supplier planning call chaired by the senior planner, tracked the actions in the shared log and chased suppliers for confirmations between calls.

experienceHighlights.text: Coordinated plan changes from production and logistics into the draft plan, flagging decisions requiring senior planner input and recording responsibility boundaries in a change log.
experienceHighlights.witness: Passed plan changes from production and logistics into the draft plan, flagging the ones that needed the senior planner's decision and recording who decided in the change log.

experienceHighlights.text: Documented known limitations and hand-over conditions at the end of each planning week through exception lists and change logs.
experienceHighlights.witness: Responsibilities included parameter maintenance, draft-plan preparation, call minutes and change logging for the small-appliance family over about two years.

projectsAndWorkSamples.text: Provided a verified work sample of a weekly draft supply plan, exception list, and change log with planning system identifiers for traceability.
projectsAndWorkSamples.witness: Work sample: one week's draft supply plan with the exception list and the change log for that week, with the planning system's plan identifiers as a verification trail.

skills.text: Supply chain planning system configuration and maintenance
skills.witness: Maintained planning parameters for the small-appliance product family in the planning system, updating lead times and safety stock after each supplier review and logging every change with its reason.

skills.text: Supplier planning call facilitation and action tracking
skills.witness: Took the minutes of the weekly supplier planning call chaired by the senior planner, tracked the actions in the shared log and chased suppliers for confirmations between calls.

skills.text: Cross-functional coordination with production and logistics
skills.witness: Passed plan changes from production and logistics into the draft plan, flagging the ones that needed the senior planner's decision and recording who decided in the change log.

optimizedCv.evidenceBoundary: The materials establish the candidate's involvement in planning activities but do not confirm authority to release purchase schedules or lead supplier planning calls independently; the senior planner held these responsibilities.

decisionBoundary.statement: Candidate's role was supportive, not independent; requires human review to assess if the candidate can operate without senior oversight.
